en: Philippians 1

p.src: 1  Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:

en: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:
u.src: 1  Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:

en:
1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”.
1:1 or, superintendents, or bishops
1:1 Or, deacons

p.src: 2  Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
u.src: 2  Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

zh: 保羅為腓立比信徒禱告

p.src: 3  I thank my God whenever I remember you,

en: I thank my God whenever I remember you,
u.src: 3  I thank my God whenever I remember you,

p.src: 4  always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,

en: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,
u.src: 4  always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,

p.src: 5  for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

en: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;
u.src: 5  for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

en: 1:5 The word translated “partnership” (κοινωνίᾳ) also means “fellowship” and “sharing”.

p.src: 6  being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

en: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
u.src: 6  being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

p.src: 7  It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

en: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.
u.src: 7  It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

p.src: 8  For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

en: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
u.src: 8  For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

p.src: 9  This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

en: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
u.src: 9  This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

p.src: 10  so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

en: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,
u.src: 10  so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

p.src: 11  being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

en: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
u.src: 11  being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

p.src: 12  Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,

en: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,
u.src: 12  Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,

en: 1:12 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

p.src: 13  so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,

en: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,
u.src: 13  so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,

en: 1:13 or, praetorian

p.src: 14  and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

en: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.
u.src: 14  and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

p.src: 15  Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

en: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.
u.src: 15  Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

p.src: 16  The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

en: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;
u.src: 16  The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

p.src: 17  but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

en: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.
u.src: 17  but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

p.src: 18  What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

en: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.
u.src: 18  What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

p.src: 19  For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

en: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
u.src: 19  For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

p.src: 20  according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.

en: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.
u.src: 20  according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.

p.src: 21  For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

en: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
u.src: 21  For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

p.src: 22  But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.

en: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.
u.src: 22  But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.

p.src: 23  But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

en: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.
u.src: 23  But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

p.src: 24  Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

en: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.
u.src: 24  Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

p.src: 25  Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,

en: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,
u.src: 25  Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,

p.src: 26  that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

en: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.
u.src: 26  that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

en: 1:26 or, rejoicing

p.src: 27  Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

en: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;
u.src: 27  Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

p.src: 28  and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.

en: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.
u.src: 28  and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.

p.src: 29  Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,

en: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,
u.src: 29  Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,

p.src: 30  having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.
